name: Celina
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Celina?
answer_short: Yes, after an inspection. Celina allows an under-speed vehicle, including a golf cart, on city streets posted 35 mph or less once it passes a police inspection and has an Ohio title and registration. Out-of-state carts are not allowed on city streets.

golf_cart.roads: City streets posted 35 mph or less
golf_cart.notes: Ohio title, police inspection, licensed driver

rules.rule: Under-speed vehicles, including golf carts, on city streets posted 35 mph or less after inspection and Ohio registration
Under-speed vehicles on roads posted 35 mph or less where the local authority allows them

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Celina?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I bring an out-of-state golf cart to Celina?
faq.a: No. The code says out-of-state multi-use vehicles are not permitted on city streets.

faq.q: Do I need a police inspection?
faq.a: Yes, before the cart is used on a city street, plus an Ohio title and registration.
